# Logos for the Icon element

These files are not covered by Kolam's AGPL-3.0 license. Each pack keeps its own terms:

| Folder | Source | Terms |
|---|---|---|
| `brand/` | [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org) | CC0 1.0 (`brand/LICENSE.md`) |
| `dev/` | [Devicon](https://devicon.dev) | MIT (`dev/LICENSE`) |
| `aws/` | [AWS Architecture Icons](https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons/) | AWS's own terms (below) |

**AWS Architecture Icons** are © Amazon Web Services, Inc. or its affiliates. AWS provides them so that customers and
partners can draw architecture diagrams. They are included unchanged, so that Kolam boards can show AWS services in such
diagrams; they are not licensed under the AGPL. Before using them for anything else, read AWS's terms on the page above.
To leave them out of your own copy, delete `aws/` and the `aws` pack in `index.json`.

Brand names and logos in all three packs are trademarks of their owners. Showing them does not imply endorsement.

`index.json` and the files here are generated by `scripts/build-logos.mjs`; usage is at the top of that script.
